meta.source_system: sampling-host teaching model: two independent switches (hand-constructed for this repository, not transcribed from a real system)
meta.purpose: host model for the check-sample example (examples/README.md, rung S). Its rewards depend only on the state you land on (+1 landing on the goal, -0.02 otherwise, 0 on the absorbing self-loop) -- the premise the sample-based reward layer needs. The other teaching models in this directory (tier1_starter_model.json, ticketfsm_milestones_model.json) have rewards that belong to the move or the action, and on those the sample-based verdict refuses at any sample size (see expected/sampling_ticketfsm_boundary_expected.json).
meta.construction: state = 2-bit string (switch_a = low bit, switch_b = high bit); action a = flip bit a (deterministic p=1.0, s -> s XOR 2**a); goal 11 (state 3) absorbing (self-loop, reward 0); reward +1.0 for a transition landing on state 3, -0.02 for any other transition
meta.visible_symmetry: swapping the two switches mirrors the machine: states 01 and 10 exchange, 00 and 11 stay put -- order 2, three orbits {0}, {1,2}, {3}
